adds 6 hulls Fractus, gust, Pocket Gust, Rime (M), Vapor and Versant, added the Dirune "Burn" EMP array New energy weapon akin to the Ion Beam,
also revamps the Artassault "Buckshot" Blunderbuss to a more fixed pattern intead of random spread and Stats tweaks.
